remarks: Opportunity to live in one Nowalk's favorite complexes. This 1 bedroom, 1 bath unit is perfect! It has the best location: Top floor in the back with the view of the pond from all windows. You can also enjoy the view from the balcony/deck off the living room. This bright and sunny combination living/ dining room also includes a wood burning fireplace. Kitchen has been updated. Vaulted ceilings in the the living room, kitchen and bedroom create an expanded sense of space. Living room, dining room and kitchen have hardwood floors. Bedroom has additional area with desk and storage cubbies for potential workspace. Laundry is in unit. Complex amenities include: pool, tennis courts, community garden, and lovely outdoor space by pond. Convenient to shopping, restaurants, beach, Rowayton, major highway. There is a pathway near community garden to walk to train. The furnace and AC are about 10 years old. Hot water heater 2 years old.Some storage over a garage building ( will get that building #) Unit parking space is 125. Rowayton Woods is a very well maintained.This is a welcoming community that is well loved by it's residents.
